name: Perseverance

definition_by_age.4: Trying again after something doesn't work.
definition_by_age.6: Perseverance means continuing to try, even after a setback.
definition_by_age.8: Perseverance is steady effort over time, trusting the process even when results take a while.

learning_objective: Children can describe trying again after not succeeding the first time.

recommended_default.note: Retrieval ranking (retrieval_ranking.md) starts from this combination and diversity-penalizes away from it on repeat use, per recommended_story_combinations.md.

qv_015.reasoning: The most famous, directly on-topic perseverance-through-hardship verse.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Losing a game and trying again fits mistake-reflection-correction.
